round_oracle: Decimal.from_float exact binary input converted to integral ROUND_HALF_UP,then double;preserve sign of zero. This independent oracle avoids binary x+0.5 rounding near halfway.
scope: Native srand,playwebm,trunc/round binding and callback behavior. Real variant converters/type changes and native seed write/read helpers execute. Cache/video/list/other callback providers are bounded. Wide integer conversion,missing slots and original undefined non-WEBM successful-video message have separate controlled outcomes;no complete video/VM/gameplay or foreign ABI claim.
